text:
Alex: heads up — after last night's console rollout we're seeing a weird pattern: clients doing a soft-close (server side 1000 then immediate reconnect) are generating two quota charges in the console for a split-second topology flip.
Priya: omg that's the report I saw this morning, thought it was noisy sampling. got a query?
Alex: i've got a small trace where the client reconnects and lands on a different route before the old session fully drains. proxy emits a 204-ish keepalive and our billing side counts both sessions for ~300ms.
Jordan: can you paste the trace id? also curious if this is only SSE or WS too.
Alex: trace=tr-9c3b, looks like SSE -> proxy soft-close -> client reconnect to new shard. WS clients seem less affected but some multiplexed flows show similar double-counting.
Maya: is this a routing sticky cookie TTL mismatch? we had that change in canary yesterday to shorten affinity for load balancing.
Priya: yes short affinity + immediate reconnect => new route gets a fresh session before old tombstone cleared. console dedupe relies on last-event-id matching, but SSE clients aren't sending it consistently.
Alex: snippet from proxy logs: ```
[proxy] 2026-03-22T02:12:34Z session end code=1000 id=abc shard=eu-west-1
[proxy] 2026-03-22T02:12:34.123 reconnect attempt id=abc new_shard=us-east-1
[billing] 2026-03-22T02:12:34.200 charge start session=abc
[billing] 2026-03-22T02:12:34.480 charge start session=abc-2
```
Jordan: billing is starting charge on handshake start, not on first token served, right? that would explain overlap.
Maya: correct, billing triggers on routing claim. if two claims overlap briefly that looks like two sessions.
Priya: console UX shows two small spikes, then merge later; ops folks see dup entries and assume customer retries. we should attribute to transient route-swap.
Alex: propose change: billing should be idempotent for same client id within a 1s window, or check last-event-id match before second charge.
Jordan: idempotency sounds safer but could hide real double sessions if client legitimately opens two connections. maybe tie to connection fingerprint (ip+user-agent+client-id).
Maya: telemetry side: we need a clear metric: overlapping-claim-duration per client id. console can surface as "potential duplicate billing" and link to traces.
Priya: for rollout: revert affinity TTL? or quick patch to billing to wait 200ms for drain? which is lower risk?
Alex: revert affinity TTL to previous value on canary for now, patch billing for longer-term.
deploy-bot: canary rollback started by Priya at 02:30 UTC.
Jordan: follow-up: add sampling for SSE clients missing last-event-id, log client headers so we can group by persistent ids. also add a small alert for >0.5% overlap rate.
Maya: noted — i'll add dashboard panel: "route-claim overlaps" and surface top client ids.
Priya: thanks. i'll watch billing-sums dashboard and correlate with deploys.
Alex: thanks all. filing a short postmortem draft and an RFC for idempotent charging semantics.
Maya: please cc infra-billing and sdks teams so they can make client changes (send last-event-id more reliably). :thumbsup:
